items.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: And when I ended up with just a saxophone section, Pat LaBarbera and Andy Weinzler from Buffalo... Of course Pat LaBarbera would come down very often to join us.

ctx.x: And when I ended up with just a saxophone section, Pat LaBarbera and Andy Weinzler from Buffalo, who is our main guy, Gerry Niewood and either Nancy Boone, who’s wonderful, or Ed Xiques played on one of the CDs, and just great players. And I have the good fortune to have Steve Gadd come and play most of them.
Okay so the stuff, the music that happened, that you helped out with Chuck and, when was this now, “Friends and Love.”
